synth.notes:
Axis (wall row a): A1/A2 move it one 3-cell row up/down and do not check piece rows, so it can overlap a piece. A3/A4 do nothing. A5 cycles axis -> pieces (largest first) -> axis.
Selected piece: A1-A4 move it 3 cells. The move is blocked by the board edge (21x21 blocks) or by another piece.
Reflection: every piece block not on the axis row mirrors to row 2a-b, on both sides of the axis. Destinations off the board or covered by any piece are skipped.
Render: layers wall<target<reflection<piece; each cell shows the topmost solid pixel, else the topmost hole fill (selected 0, reflection 4). Objects are re-extracted as 4-connected parts (wall/player parts include all 0 cells) and ranked by bbox top-left. Targets are taken per sprite.
Step-71 'reflection gone/resized' is the reflections being re-extracted after the axis moves while a piece overlaps its row. Unconfirmed: piece cycle order with more than 2 pieces, and splitting merged pieces statelessly when the axis is selected.
